remarks: Welcome to this 2016 sq ft, 4 bedroom, 2 full bath home in Pembroke School District. The lot features a private backyard setting, surrounded with beautiful farmland. This property is full of potential and ready for you to bring your vision and make it your own. The home welcomes you with a spacious, open living and dining area. A good size eat in  kitchen with plenty of counter and cabinet space. Kitchen appliances stay. The first floor includes a bedroom and full bath, while the second floor offers three additional spacious bedrooms and another full bath, giving you flexible living options. An attached 2.5 car garage adds convenience. Pembroke Central School District. Just minutes from NYS Thruway, Shopping, entertainment, restaurants, theme park, and more. Showings and negotiations start Friday, August 7th at 6PM.
